label: Imperial ship of the line
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production RTS Russian culture vessel sprite. STRICTLY TRUE 90-DEGREE DIRECTLY OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW. Bow points toward SCREEN BOTTOM, stern toward top. Entire ship and all oars/yards fit within square transparent canvas with at least 8 percent clear guard. Only deck surfaces and roofs are visible; no upright doors, hull side walls, front elevations or oblique perspective. Realistic hand-painted textured game art matching reference, clean readable silhouettes at 48/64/128px, restrained weathering, crisp dark edges, balanced overhead light. One vessel only, transparent alpha background, no water, wake, ground shadow, scene, labels, letters, flag fabric, people, side-view inset or UI. Subject: Russian imperial age-of-sail two-deck ship-of-the-line inspired, wide dark wooden hull, tan open deck and three masts with square sails partly furled along horizontal yards, rows of 8 short dark iron cannon barrels projecting on EACH side, ornate restrained stern roof, visible deck cannon crews omitted. Readable combat silhouette. No giant sails obscuring deck. CAD PLAN camera. Three masts show ONLY small circular end-on mast tops, sails as narrow horizontal furled rolls and straight yards across deck. NO vertical mast shafts drawn in image plane, no stern windows, no walls, no domes, no cross. Hull is realistically wider than medieval ships.
Correction: Edit the reference RTS ship sprite: preserve the vessel design, cannon, overhead camera and wood textures. Completely REMOVE the broad tan shaded glow/backdrop surrounding the vessel. All pixels outside the vessel must be fully transparent, absolutely no cast shadow, no halo, no gradient. Center entire vessel on a SQUARE transparent canvas with 8 percent clear margin, no cropping. Bow remains at bottom. Do not change the vessel itself.
conversion: Uniform alpha-bounds fit, Lanczos resampling and transparent padding only; original retained unchanged.

animationApproval.scope: All 17 fleet masters from the eight-age tech-tree roster

integrationStatus: art review only; no gameplay or match renderer changes
historicalScope: Era-inspired role design, not an exact reconstruction of a named vessel
